_comment: Non-credential host settings, committed so they are the same for everyone and
reviewable in version control. Credentials and DATABASE_URL are NOT here and
are never read from this file -- they stay in .env, which is gitignored.
INCIDENTGATE_ALLOW_PROVIDER_SPEND is deliberately absent. It is an
authorisation, not a setting: committing it would make a deliberate act in one
shell into a standing property of the repository, which is the opposite of what
Every key here may be overridden by an environment variable of the same name,
so a one-off port change or a CI tweak needs no edit to a committed file. A
loader test asserts this file contains no credential-shaped key.
_unset_comment: null means 'a known setting with no value', which is not the same as a key
nobody has heard of. Both are only required when PROPOSAL_PROVIDER is 'model',
and the committed default is 'deterministic'. Writing empty strings instead
would claim they are configured to be empty.
